def shrink_traced_types(traces: Iterable[CallTrace], max_typed_dict_size: int
    ) ->Tuple[Dict[str, type], Optional[type], Optional[type]]:
    traces_list = list(traces)
    
    # Collect all argument types by parameter name
    arg_types_by_name: DefaultDict[str, List[type]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    return_types: List[type] = []
    yield_types: List[type] = []
    
    for trace in traces_list:
        # Collect argument types
        for arg_name, arg_type in trace.arg_types.items():
            arg_types_by_name[arg_name].append(arg_type)
        
        # Collect return types
        if trace.return_type is not None:
            return_types.append(trace.return_type)
        
        # Collect yield types
        if trace.yield_type is not None:
            yield_types.append(trace.yield_type)
    
    # Shrink argument types
    shrunk_arg_types: Dict[str, type] = {}
    for arg_name, types in arg_types_by_name.items():
        shrunk_arg_types[arg_name] = shrink_types(types)
    
    # Shrink return types
    shrunk_return_type: Optional[type] = None
    if return_types:
        shrunk_return_type = shrink_types(return_types)
    
    # Shrink yield types
    shrunk_yield_type: Optional[type] = None
    if yield_types:
        shrunk_yield_type = shrink_types(yield_types)
    
    return shrunk_arg_types, shrunk_return_type, shrunk_yield_type
